title: Vel’kaen Heizor
dek: A watchful expedition companion who scouts the flank and suspects an unfamiliar stone may be tracking the party.

body:
Vel’kaen joins the northern expedition to find Vey and Vaa. The earlier archive label is retained, and the later quest adds witnessed scouting and participation without supplying a complete earlier biography.

Prominence and evidence

Prominence unrated. The source footprint alone does not establish the importance of this identity. Consequences, institutional or witness role and relationships need a supported assessment.

Recorded presence combines dialogue volume and span. A brief appearance can still have lasting consequences; missing context is left unrated rather than assigned a low importance.

Archive record

The census records 1 posts across 2025-05-18 → 2025-05-18. These dates identify when messages were posted, not automatically when events happened. An encounter label can refer to a form, a collective or more than one scene identity.

Watching the approaches

Vel’kaen travels with the six-person northern party, prepares for the night attack and later flanks the approach to the mountain refuge. An unfamiliar magical stone found in a pack prompts her suspicion of a tracker; the company discards it, but its mechanism is not independently identified.

She stays outside the main conversation while the siblings greet the party. That position does not establish agreement with every pledge made inside, a permanent allegiance or a later fate.
